paragraphs: At the start of a shift, collect blueprints and stock, calibrate tool offsets, and secure the workpiece. Start the lathe and listen to the cut, pausing to gauge dimensions. Change tools and adjust parameters, send each completed batch for inspection, then clear chips and inspect the machine before leaving.
